name: Whisparr Sync
description: Not built yet: this release registers the extension and a placeholder settings surface, nothing more. When built it will connect Cove to the Whisparr instance you configure, calling outward to it over the network and authenticating with the API key you supply. It will expose inbound API endpoints under /api/extensions/com.alextomas955.whisparrsync; every one of them is gated on a Cove permission, and none is anonymous. Only actions you start can cause Whisparr to download anything. Your Whisparr API key is held server-side in Cove and is never sent to the browser. Runs no scraper and no downloader code of its own.
author: alextomas955
